repos_data.description: MCP server that lets AI agents query SQL databases in natural language - read-only, with column masking, row caps, and query limits. SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL.
A MCP (model context protocol) server that gives the LLM access to and knowledge about relational databases like SQLite, Postgresql, MySQL & MariaDB, Oracle, and MS-SQL.
A general-purpose MCP server that lets AI work with multiple databases within clear boundaries.
A non-validating SQL parser module for Python
An experimental embedded SQL engine in C++20. Query Parquet, CSV, JSON, Arrow, Avro, SQLite, and Excel files directly with SQL, in-process. Early-stage.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants to query and analyze Azure Data Explorer databases through standardized interfaces.
TypeScript & JavaScript ORM for Node.js — supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server, Oracle, and more.
High-performance SQL parser, formatter, linter & security scanner for Go - 1.5M+ ops/sec, multi-dialect, zero-copy, race-free
Feature-rich ORM for modern Node.js and TypeScript, it supports PostgreSQL (with JSON and JSONB support), MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, MS SQL Server, Snowflake, Oracle DB, DB2 and DB2 for IBM i.
executes SQL against CSV, TSV, LTSV, JSON, JSONL, Parquet, Microsoft Excel™ , ACH, and Fedwire files with shell.
Modern and easy to use SQL client for MySQL, Postgres, SQLite, SQL Server, and more. Linux, MacOS, and Windows.
🚀 A lightweight, framework-agnostic database migration tool.

repo_meta_data.description: An MCP server that executes SQL via ConnectorX and streams (using Arrow RecordBatch) the result to CSV or Parquet. Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, MS SQL Server, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery
